title: 第17章 气门被破陈天龙身死第18章 江南地下新王者
content_zh:
“真气护体，怎么可能？”
陈天龙脸色大变，这可是宗师武者才能做到的真气外放。
但很快，他就看出来，这根本不是真元护体。
“不管你用的是什么妖术，今夜你必死无疑。”
陈天龙开始猛烈攻击，拳头密密麻麻击在符箓护罩上。
拳力十分恐怖，不到片刻，护罩就被打破。
护罩被破一瞬间，张扬双手交叉挡在胸前。
砰！
一拳轰在手臂上，强大的肉身力量，将张扬连续震退十几步。
张扬暗暗叫苦，还是大意了，早知道再修一段时间再说。
他靠着元气在苦苦支撑，希望妖姬能快点解决一群保镖，过来分担自己的压力。
一看妖姬那边，差点吐血，妖姬被一群人包围，根本无法过来。
“不能再藏拙了，否则，只有死路一条。”
张扬摸出飞剑符激活，飞剑符化成一道白光，朝妖姬那边射去。
连片惨叫声响起，包围妖姬的十几名保镖全部倒地，非死即伤。
妖姬趁机解决另外几名保镖，过来跟张扬汇合。
“你们能在这么短的时间，突破先天高手境界，修炼的不可能是古武。”见张扬连续祭出符箓，陈天龙眼神中露出火热，“如果我没猜错，你们修炼的，一定是传闻中的修仙之法。”
张扬跟妖姬相视一眼，同时进攻。
两人的秘密绝对不能传出去，否则会有无数强者过来逼问他们要修仙之法。
可惜，哪怕两人联手，依然不是对手。

陈天龙一拳将张扬震飞，右脚踩在妖姬胸口上，冷冷道：“天堂有路你不走，地狱无门你偏闯。”
他挥起拳头，狠狠砸落。
“住手。”
张扬双目欲裂，想要救援，根本来不及。
以陈天龙的拳力，这一拳能将妖姬脑袋打爆。
千钧一发之际，妖姬突然抬起右手。
啾！
细微声音响起，一支暗箭射在陈天龙腋下。
陈天龙强壮的身体肉眼可见地虚弱起来，一拳打在妖姬头上，软绵无力。
妖姬弹身而起，右手划过，喉咙割破的声音响起。
“贱人，你怎么知道我气门所在？”
陈天龙倒在地上，身体不断抽搐，血流了一地。
content_en:
"Infuriating body protection, how is that possible?"
Chen Tianlong's expression changed drastically. This was something only a master warrior could do to release his true energy.
But soon, he saw that this was not the True Essence Body Protector at all.
"No matter what kind of magic you use, you will definitely die tonight."
Chen Tianlong began to attack violently, hitting the talisman shield with his fists.
The power of the punch was terrifying, and within a moment, the shield was broken.
The moment the shield was broken, Zhang Yang crossed his hands in front of his chest.
Bang!
A punch hit his arm, and the powerful physical force knocked Zhang Yang back more than ten steps.
Zhang Yang complained secretly, he was still careless, he would have known better if he had to practice for a while.
He was relying on his vitality to support himself, hoping that Enchantress could quickly deal with a group of bodyguards and come over to share his pressure.
When I looked at the side of the enchantress, I almost vomited blood. The enchantress was surrounded by a group of people and couldn't come over at all.
"We can no longer hide our clumsiness, otherwise, there will only be a dead end."
Zhang Yang took out the Flying Sword Talisman and activated it. The Flying Sword Talisman turned into a white light and shot toward the Enchantress.
Continuous screams rang out, and the dozen or so bodyguards surrounding the Enchantress all fell to the ground, either dead or injured.
Enchantress took the opportunity to deal with the other bodyguards and came to join Zhang Yang.
"You can break through the realm of innate masters in such a short period of time. You cannot be practicing ancient martial arts." Seeing Zhang Yang continuously offering talismans, Chen Tianlong's eyes showed fire. "If I guess correctly, what you practice must be the rumored method of cultivating immortals."
Zhang Yang and Enchantress looked at each other and attacked at the same time.
The secrets between the two people must not be spread out, otherwise countless powerful people will come and ask them for the method of cultivating immortals.
It's a pity that even if the two of them join forces, they are still no match.
Chen Tianlong punched Zhang Yang and knocked him away. He stepped on the Enchantress's chest with his right foot and said coldly: "There is a way to heaven but you don't take it. If there is no way to hell, you just go through it."
He raised his fist and smashed it down hard.
"Stop."
Zhang Yang's eyes were splitting, and he wanted to rescue him, but it was too late.
With Chen Tianlong's punching power, this punch can blow the Enchantress's head off.
At the critical moment, the enchantress suddenly raised her right hand.
Chirp!
A subtle voice sounded, and a hidden arrow shot into Chen Tianlong's armpit.
Chen Tianlong's strong body became visibly weak, and he punched the enchantress on the head, making her weak.
The enchantress jumped up, crossed her right hand, and heard the sound of her throat being cut.
"Bitch, how do you know where my valve is?"
Chen Tianlong fell to the ground, his body twitching continuously, and blood flowed all over the floor.
